claim: exercisedb.dev now presents itself as AscendAPI, previously ExerciseDB.
quote: Previously ExerciseDB

claim: AscendAPI's documentation names github.com/ExerciseDB/exercisedb-api as its GitHub.
quote: [Github](https://github.com/ExerciseDB/exercisedb-api)

claim: The free V1 tier is 1,500 exercises with 180p GIFs and needs no authentication.
quote: 1,500 exercises with 180p GIFs. No authentication required, just call the hosted API directly.

claim: The free V1 endpoint is oss.exercisedb.dev/api/v1/exercises.
quote: https://oss.exercisedb.dev/api/v1/exercises

claim: The free V1 endpoint reported a total of 1,500 exercises when read on October 22, 2026.
quote: "total":1500

claim: AscendAPI describes the whole V1 dataset as over 2,000 exercises, available as a free hosted tier and a paid RapidAPI tier.
quote: featuring over 2,000 structured exercises with rich metadata, images, and GIFs. Available as a free hosted tier and a paid RapidAPI tier with enhanced features.

claim: Free V1 media is 180p GIFs only; 360p to 1080p images and GIFs are on the paid RapidAPI tier.
quote: The free tier includes 180p GIFs only . Multi-resolution images and GIFs (360p–1080p) are available on the paid RapidAPI tier .

claim: AscendAPI's quickstart calls the V2 Basic plan completely free.
quote: Select the Basic plan it’s completely free:

claim: The free Basic plan includes 2,000 requests a month.
quote: 2,000 requests / month

claim: The free Basic plan includes 200 exercises in the library.
quote: 200 exercises in library

claim: The free Basic plan includes exercise images and videos.
quote: Exercise images & videos

claim: The free Basic plan needs no credit card.
quote: No credit card required

claim: Both V2 tiers are accessed via RapidAPI, and free-tier media is watermarked.
quote: Both free and paid tiers are accessed via RapidAPI. The only difference is that free tier media is watermarked .

claim: The paid V2 tier serves watermark-free media.
quote: Paid tier serves clean, watermark-free assets across all resolutions.

claim: AscendAPI describes ExerciseDB V2 as 11,000+ exercises, 15,000+ videos and 20,000+ images.
quote: A multipurpose exercise dataset with 11,000+ exercises, 15,000+ videos, and 20,000+ images

claim: AscendAPI's free plans are limited to 1,000 requests per hour per API key.
quote: All free plans include a limit of 1,000 requests per hour per API key.

claim: AscendAPI's paid plans have no strict rate limit.
quote: Paid plans have no strict rate limit.

claim: AscendAPI says media served through its CDN is generally unlimited.
quote: is served through our CDN and is generally unlimited

claim: AscendAPI is accessed via RapidAPI, with a RapidAPI account and an active subscription.
quote: You will need a RapidAPI account and an active subscription to authenticate your requests.

claim: The exercisedb-api repository carries an AGPL-3.0 LICENSE file (a git clone on 2026-10-22 showed only README.md and LICENSE, last commit 2025-11-25).
quote: GNU AFFERO GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE

claim: The README links separate terms of use, which we could not open.
quote: Terms Of Use

claim: API Ninjas says all paid plans are premium plans.
quote: All paid plans (Developer, Business, Professional, Enterprise) are premium plans.

claim: API Ninjas' Free plan is for evaluation and demo purposes only.
quote: Evaluation and demo purposes only - no payment information required

claim: The Free plan: 3,000 calls a month, no commercial use, no caching or storing, 100 calls an hour, attribution required.
quote: API calls per month 3,000 Commercial use No Data caching/storing allowed No Rate limiting 100 API calls per hour Attribution required Yes

claim: API Ninjas lists monthly and yearly prices, yearly at 34% off.
quote: Monthly Yearly 34% off

claim: The Developer plan is listed at $59 a month, or $39 a month on yearly billing.
quote: $ 59 $ 39 / month

claim: Developer: 100,000 calls a month, commercial use allowed, caching or storing data not allowed.
quote: API calls per month 100,000 Commercial use Yes Data caching/storing allowed No

claim: The Business plan is listed at $149 a month, or $99 a month on yearly billing.
Business: 1,000,000 calls a month, commercial use and caching or storing allowed.
quote: API calls per month 1,000,000 Commercial use Yes Data caching/storing allowed Yes

claim: The Professional plan is listed at $299 a month, or $199 a month on yearly billing.
Professional: 10,000,000 calls a month.
quote: API calls per month 10,000,000

claim: The /v1/exercises endpoint returns up to 5 exercises per request.
quote: Returns up to 5 exercises that satisfy the given parameters.

claim: Paging past the first results uses the premium offset parameter.
quote: you can page through more using the premium offset parameter

claim: API Ninjas documents an images field of image URLs in movement order, usually start and finish positions.
quote: Array of image URLs showing the exercise, in movement order (usually the start and finish positions).

claim: Images are included only on premium plans.
quote: On premium plans, exercises with photos also include an images array of image URLs in movement order.

claim: /v1/allexercises needs the Business tier or above, or any annual plan.
quote: Business tier and above, or any annual plan

claim: Commercial use of the Exercises API is not permitted on the free tier.
quote: Commercial use of the Exercises API is not permitted on the free tier.

claim: free-exercise-db's README calls it an open public domain exercise dataset with 800+ exercises; our count of dist/exercises.json at commit f00c92c (2026-09-27) on 2026-10-22 found 876 records and 1,746 JPEG image paths.
quote: Open Public Domain Exercise Dataset in `JSON` format, 800+ exercises
